notes: Passive dynamic (moving-coil) cardioid broadcast microphone with Variable-D design; requires no external/phantom power. Single balanced audio output on a 3-pin XLR male connector (pin 2 hot), 150 ohms balanced output impedance, 45 Hz-18 kHz frequency response. No bandwidth grade applies since XLR3 analog audio connectors are not in the graded connector list. A "RE20-BLACK" color variant exists with identical electrical specs. No rack mounting (handheld/stand-mounted mic, not rack equipment).

ports.name: Audio Output
ports.note: 3-pin XLR male, transformer-balanced, 150 ohms, pin 2 positive/hot
